text:
elaine: Heads-up: I'm getting PR feedback on the Console observability page that the cost/latency heuristic table needs clearer examples and one of the tracing hook snippets references an old SDK helper. Can we coordinate quick fixes so we don't block the docs release?

jm: I can tackle the table examples. Which workloads should we use for the examples? Small chat session + batch embeddings? Suggest adding a tiny calculation showing tokens -> estimated cost.

phil: I'll patch the tracing snippet. It references `attach_trace(ctx)` which is deprecated; new API is `TraceContext.with_id(trace_id)`. Will add a short migration blurb. Also found a stale inline link to /sdk/py/trace-helper; should be /sdk/py/trace-context.

ci-bot: PR #4892 by elaine: lint OK, preview build failed (missing asset: /static/images/heatmap-legend.svg).

ryan: I can add the asset to the repo and update the img tag to use the new responsive SVG. Also, I noticed the dashboard JSON example had an extra field `bucket_order: desc` which the runtime ignores; we should remove it from the sample to avoid confusion.

elaine: Great. @jm add the token-cost math and one tiny example for a 128-token response. @phil update the snippet and link. @ryan add the SVG and remove the extra field from the dashboard sample. If CI green we can merge; otherwise we'll iterate.

jm: Added two table rows: "chat-small (128 tokens) -> est $0.0019" and "batch-embed (avg 512 tokens across 10 items) -> est $0.0123". Left a short note about variability and quantization effects.

phil: Snippet updated and migration note added. Replaced `attach_trace(ctx)` with::

```python
from redwood.trace import TraceContext
with TraceContext.with_id("t-abc123") as ctx:
    client.call("generate", input="hello world")
```

Also fixed the broken link to /sdk/py/trace-context.

ryan: Uploaded heatmap-legend.svg and removed `bucket_order`. CI rerun queued.

ci-bot: Preview build success. Docs smoke tests passed.

elaine: Thanks all. I'll merge after a quick copy edit. Post-merge action: add a tiny note in the migration guide referencing the trace helper removal so customers searching won't be confused.

jm: quick +1.

phil: +1.

ryan: +1, and opened follow-up ticket DOCS-456 to track any additional sample cleanup.

elaine: Merging now. Will ping #release-notes once live. :rocket:
